messages:
Emma L: Heads-up team — deploying model-route v3 and enabling feature flag `geo-new-routing` tonight at 22:00 UTC. Plan is geo-staggered: EU -> NA -> APAC. Ramp steps: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 15m soak per step. Telemetry gates: p95 latency, error-rate, and 99th token latency. Runbook: https://runbooks/redwood/geo-ramp-2026

Raj P: Thanks — are we pinning v2 fallback for EU during the rollout? last time EU had the spike and we needed a hard pin.

Emma L: Yes planning to leave v2 pinned for EU while we do initial 5%. If metrics degrade beyond thresholds we rollback to v2, not just disable the flag.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled by Emma L at 2026-03-21T22:00:00Z. Canary allocation: eu-west-1 (5% traffic). Will post progress and alerts.

Sarah D: Add a circuit-breaker rule: if error-rate > 1.5% OR p95 increases by >30% vs baseline for 2 consecutive 5m windows, auto-dial back to 0% for that region and notify #eng-oncall. Also include a manual quick-disable command in runbook.

Jordan C: Also note: traffic shaping for EU must exclude internal staging traffic — make sure the ff cohort excludes `internal_*` prefixes. Last deploy we saw warmup noise from staging.

Emma L: Good catch. I'll update the toggle command and runbook snippet. Quick commands for ops:
```
# set 5% for EU
/ff toggle geo-new-routing --cohort eu --pct 5 --exclude internal_*
# bump to 25%
/ff toggle geo-new-routing --cohort eu --pct 25
# emergency disable
/ff toggle geo-new-routing --pct 0 --reason "auto-disable: metric spike"
```

Raj P: For rollout pacing, propose 30m between EU->NA and NA->APAC (longer than 15m) because NA has higher qps and we need stable baselining. Keep EU at 15m.

Emma L: OK agree: EU 15m soak, then NA 30m, APAC 15m. Documented in runbook now.

OpsBot: Telemetry hooks configured: p95_latency, request_error_rate, token_cost_rate. Alerts will ping #eng-oncall and send an SMS to oncall.

Sarah D: Add an explicit rollback play: if APAC shows tail-latency regressions post-100% for >30m, rollback global to v2 across regions and file a postmortem.

Emma L: Noted. Release notes summary (for product & support): "Enabling geo-new-routing: phased rollout to improve latency in EU/NA with model-route v3. Will monitor p95 latency and error rates; rollback plan pinned to v2 if thresholds exceeded."

deploy-bot: Deploy started. Canary EU at 5% now. Monitoring channels: #eng-releases, #eng-oncall. Will report back on health checks at 5m and 15m. :rocket:

Jordan C: :thumbsup: I'll stand by for the NA bump and confirm the exclusion list is respected.

Emma L: Thanks all — callout to oncall: be ready for a manual rollback window 22:20-23:30 UTC. If anything odd ping me directly.

deploy-bot: Canary EU healthy at 5% (5m check). No error spikes. Proceed when ready.

Raj P: Proceeding to 25% NA in 3m.

(End of thread)
